evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from ~28,800 ppm to 13.9 ppm, and it stayed at 4-7 ppm afterward
Thermocouple stayed within ~1 °C of setpoint throughout the ramp, and heater power rose smoothly
Brief 10.6 °C overshoot at the start of growth settled to 750.0 °C, with heater power steady at ~45%
Pressure held at ~760 Torr and Ar at ~100 sccm, matching setpoint
Controller reports running, which matches the live telemetry changes

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet (e.g. Raman or microscopy after growth), so I can't say whether the target material grew. No normal-run reference values were provided to compare against.
